url.description: Document URL validated by the installation egress policy. Required for prices; omit for a catalog source to read the catalog this release ships. A fetched catalog is verified with its detached signature at the same URL plus .sig.

PriceOperation.description: An operation registered by this release, including generation, decision, embeddings, rerank, moderation, classification, scoring and token_count. Unknown operations are rejected.

cache_write_1h_input_per_million.description:
Rate for the 1-hour TTL share of cache writes. Omit to bill
it at the generic cache-write rate, then the input rate.

cache_write_5m_input_per_million.description:
Rate for the 5-minute TTL share of cache writes. Omit to bill
it at the generic cache-write rate, then the input rate.

cache_write_input_per_million.description:
Rate for the generic cache-write share of the input tokens.
Omit to bill cache writes at the full input rate.

cached_input_per_million.description:
Rate for the cached share of the input tokens. Omit to bill cached
tokens at the full input rate.

provider_id.description: Scopes the price to one provider. A price for plugin providers names its provider: no kind-wide or vendor price applies to them.

audio_input_per_million.description: Rate for the audio share of the input tokens. Omit to bill audio input at the input rate.

cached_audio_input_per_million.description: Rate for the cached share of audio input tokens. Omit to bill it at the cached input rate, then the input rate.

audio_output_per_million.description: Rate for the audio share of the output tokens. Omit to bill it at the output rate.

image_input_per_million.description: Rate for the image share of the input tokens. Omit to bill image input at the input rate.

cached_image_input_per_million.description: Rate for the cached share of image input tokens. Omit to bill it at the cached input rate, then the input rate.

image_output_per_million.description: Rate for the image share of the output tokens. Omit to bill it at the output rate.

per_request.description: A fixed fee charged once per successful attempt.

batch_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the whole usage charge of usage marked as batch. Usage marked batch with no multiplier is unpriced.

tiers.description: Input-token tiers, ascending by above_input_tokens. The highest exceeded tier replaces the entry's per-million rate set.

training_per_million.description: Exact currency rate per million training tokens.

storage_per_gib_day.description: Exact currency rate per GiB-day; GiB is 2^30 bytes.

cache_storage_per_million_token_hour.description: Exact currency rate per million cached token-hours.

container_per_session.description: Exact per-session rates keyed by native memory tier, for example 1g or 4g.

effective_at.description: Defaults to now; must not be in the past.
